name: Júzcar (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of light blue, orange-brown and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Júzcar (a tree, a castle and a mine).
history: Municipal flag of Júzcar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Júzcar arms — tree, castle and mine on green
